remarks: Several genuinely official Jharkhand government domains (shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in, jiada.jharkhand.gov.in) are legitimate per cross-reference from verified jharkhand.gov.in pages, but their TLS certificates fail chain validation in this session even against the proxy's full CA bundle — this looks like a server-side misconfiguration on the state's NIC-hosted infrastructure rather than a proxy issue, since other jharkhand.gov.in subpaths verified fine over TLS.

advantage.jharkhand.gov.in (the state's actual Single Window Clearance System, where the Factory License / Factory Plan Approval application is reportedly filed via a Combined Application Form) is confirmed as the correct, current portal by two independently-verified official pages (jharkhand.gov.in/industries and third-party corroboration), but it was unreachable (connection reset/timeout) from this session on every attempt, so no URL on that domain could be included in verifiedSources.

A notable false-positive risk found during search: multiple 'Jharkhand factory license checklist' queries returned singlewindow.jk.gov.in results — these belong to Jammu & Kashmir (jk.gov.in), not Jharkhand; verified and excluded.

services.india.gov.in and gad.jharkhand.gov.in were outright refused by the session's egress proxy as hosts not allowed for this session (not a content issue) — a different fetch environment might reach them.

No official egazette/jharkhandgazette.* domain could be located or reached this session, so the authoritative gazette text of the Jharkhand Factories Rules 1950 and its various amendments (including the 2025 amendment) could not be directly verified from a government-hosted gazette copy; the closest verified official source discussing factory licensing is the gazette-published Jharkhand Industrial and Investment Policy 2021 PDF (mirrored on a central government chemicals.gov.in domain), included above.

Given the above gaps, verifiedSources should be treated as a partial but honestly-verified set; the state's primary application portal (advantage.jharkhand.gov.in / shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in) exists and is well-attested by the sources that WERE verified, but its own pages could not be fetched successfully this session.
